versions.subject: Added rule for Defender DLL sideloading
versions.detection:
selection: 
    Image|endswith: '\MpCmdRun.exe'
legit_path:
    Image|startswith: # MpCmdRun resides in two locations
      - 'C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\'
      - 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Platform\'
condition: selection and not legit_path
versions.spl: Image="*\\MpCmdRun.exe" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\*", "C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\*"))
